author: Insta360
description:
"When life gives you a wheelchair, find a skatepark" 🤘

Aaron Fotheringham, better known as @Wheelz, never set out to invent a sport. He just wanted to ride. Check out how the world's first wheelchair backflip led him to invent WCMX (wheelchair motocross) and perform at Nitro Circus around the world 😎

Read more here: https://www.insta360.com/blog/creator-stories/wcmx-wheelchair-motocross-inventor-wheelz-interview.html
